creator: Ayo Omolewa (@ayoships)
hypothesis: Localized metadata and language-specific search discovery may improve qualified organic installs in under-served markets.
experiment: Identify an existing eligible mobile app; do not invent one
Compare relevant query demand, competition, and conversion by country/language
Review Apple App Store and Google Play metadata policies independently
Translate with locale-specific human quality review
Run measured market-specific experiments, recording impressions, installs, retention and verified economics
constraints: No fake localization claims or keyword stuffing
Do not assume English-only apps are acceptable in all markets
Do not treat search popularity as proven sales
